name: Kali Temple
town_description: Longleng is a remote district headquarters town in northern Nagaland, home of the Phom Naga tribe. It sits in steep, forested hills and is one of the least-visited district towns in the state. The population is overwhelmingly Christian, with only a very small Hindu presence.
